# is-my.app

> Free subdomains for apps: get `your-app-name.is-my.app` with one JSON file and one pull request.

Point a name at an app you already host (GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages or your own server) with DNS records, or give us a public GitHub repo and we build it and host it on Cloudflare Pages. Fork the repo, add `domains/<app-name>.json`, open a pull request, and a bot validates it. Valid pull requests are merged automatically and the app goes live within a few minutes. The registry of live apps is also available as JSON.

## Links

- [Home](https://is-my.app/): browse live apps and claim a subdomain
- [Source and how to claim a name](https://github.com/jn-aman/is-my.app): README with the full steps and rules
- [Domain file schema](https://github.com/jn-aman/is-my.app/blob/main/schema/domain.schema.json): JSON schema for `domains/<name>.json`
- [Registry API, JSON](https://is-my.app/domains.json): list of all registered apps
- [Terms](https://github.com/jn-aman/is-my.app/blob/main/TERMS.md): rules every subdomain must follow
